comment: Under the CAEP Interop profile only: the CI receiver configurations deliberately declare a Complex Subject so events are generated for it; Complex Subjects are not yet listed in CAEP Interop Profile 2.5, see https://github.com/openid/sharedsignals/issues/351

The emulated transmitter of the paired receiver test sends events for the Complex Subject declared in the CI receiver configuration; Complex Subjects are not yet listed in CAEP Interop Profile 2.5, see https://github.com/openid/sharedsignals/issues/351. The block name varies with the event type that carries the Complex Subject, hence the wildcard

The dynamic-auth pairings run the transmitter negative openid-ssf-stream-control-error-token-in-uri-query, which deliberately sends the access token as a URI query parameter to check that the transmitter rejects it (CAEP Interop Profile 2.7.2); the emulated transmitter grades that receiver behaviour as a failure

The paired receiver module openid-ssf-receiver-stream-caep-interop deliberately sends one credential-change event whose credential_type is outside the list of CAEP 1.0 3.3.1 (which allows any type supported mutually), to check that the receiver does not report it as an error; the transmitter test warns about the non-standard value as a sender-side check
